deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: Returned life, grave-bound vitality, preserved identity, and communal memory place the Djiumōtiakić closest to the administrator of death.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Hathruna
deities.rationale: Their existence between death and renewed life reflects rot transformed into rebirth rather than simple undeath.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Eirzunet
deities.rationale: Ash-recorded identity and twilight transformation connect some lineages to Eirzunet’s shadowed rites.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
